title: The OLE2 readers get a range source, and the first price list for one
decision: harness change retained, first descriptive baseline retained, no production change
code_state: no file under crates/ was modified by this change; tools/perf-baseline and docs only
reason_codes: change 0587's evidence gap 4 recorded three independent OOXML range-source mechanisms and no OLE2 one, and recorded that closing it is harness plumbing because the CFB readers already take litchi_core::ReadAt

docs/GOAL.md names caller-supplied remote and range sources as a benchmarked dimension for both priority formats, so the programme could rank an OLE2 change on instructions, cycles, bytes and allocations but not on what it costs a caller who pays per request

change 0587 ranks XLS-6 partly on '+46 requests, a range-source regression' and had to call that cost modelled; this record supplies the denominator, 53 requests and a 58.39 ms modelled service floor for the flagship open, so the same change adds 78.8% to the open's modelled request cost while removing at most 30% of its instructions
the fourteen selectors are opt-in and absent from Case::DEFAULT, so no existing selector, corpus identity or default-matrix row changes and the checked default catalog SHA-256 does not move

accepted_evidence.deterministic_counts: logical read calls and bytes, physical request count and bytes, and the sorted request-size distribution with fixed buckets, for 17 fixture/scenario pairs over 4 real OLE2 fixtures; identical on all 50 retained samples of both transports
accepted_evidence.request_sequence_identity: SHA-256 of the complete ordered (offset, requested, returned) sequence per retained sample; one digest per range-source leg across its 50 samples, on every leg, which is change 0572's determinism property applied per selector
accepted_evidence.cross_transport_identity: for every fixture and scenario the range-source and owned-source legs agree on logical read calls, logical read bytes and the observation; scripts/summarize.py fails the summary otherwise
accepted_evidence.paired_timing: p50/p95/p99/mean per leg over 50 retained samples, 20 warm-ups, CPU 20, one window
accepted_evidence.aa_floor: the 17 owned-source control legs repeated back to back in the same window; worst |delta| at p50 is 1.71% and all 17 rows are inside it
accepted_evidence.typed_refusals: two refusals frozen as scenario oracles and measured rather than dropped: ConditionalFormattingSamples.xls full text after 394 requests and 790,147 bytes, and 45543.ppt one-shape text after 73 logical reads and 792,661 bytes

accepted_costs.modelled_elapsed: range-source elapsed is sleep-driven arithmetic over a deterministic request count; the modelled service floor is 86.7% to 94.8% of the range leg's median, so these rows price the configured transport model and not a network
accepted_costs.delay_counters_are_targets: per changes 0447 and 0448 the retained delay counters are requested targets, not observed sleeping time; OS sleep granularity adds oversleep that is never subtracted and the per-call model implements no shared-link scheduler
accepted_costs.in_memory_sources: every source is in-memory bytes, so nothing here measures the page cache, a filesystem, a device or the fstat per source observation that change 0587 identified on the from_path route
accepted_costs.shared_host: the owned-source control legs are CPU-bound and were taken with seven other agents active; their A/A floor is reported and is the only basis on which their medians should be read
accepted_costs.one_transport_point: a single (1 ms, 100 MiB/s, 64 KiB) point; nothing is claimed about another latency, bandwidth or range cap
accepted_costs.model_difference_from_0572: 0572's probe serves a capped request as a short read and lets the caller loop; this simulator loops the cap inside one read_at. Request counts agree; call boundaries do not. 0572's model has no per-request overhead term, so the overhead parameter is set to zero

known_gaps.formats: change 0587's gap 4 names CFB, XLS, DOC and PPT; this record covers XLS and PPT. No DOC facade selector and no CFB-level range-source selector was added
known_gaps.corpus: four fixtures, the largest 1.4 MB, none with a DIFAT or 4,096-byte sectors; the caller-named file is not a repository-fixed corpus and is not in the schema-2 catalog
known_gaps.refusal_breadth: the two typed refusals are observed on the fixtures measured and on four further PPT decks spot-checked by hand; no corpus-wide refusal rate is derived, which is change 0587's evidence gap 3 and not this record's
known_gaps.scenarios: the all-cells and full-text scenarios walk one worksheet, not the whole workbook; no save, edit or publication scenario runs over a range source

withheld: any speedup, regression, cold-cache, physical-device, network, page-cache, allocation, peak-RSS, instruction-count, syscall, concurrency-scaling or cross-platform result
any statement that the measured range-source elapsed times are latencies rather than a transport model's arithmetic
any corpus-wide statement about how often the XLS full-text or PPT one-shape-text paths refuse

gates.cargo_test: 513 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored in the library; 12 + 2 + 4 passed across binary targets; 0 failed anywhere
gates.python_unittest: 23 of 26 tools/test_*.py modules OK; 3 pre-existing failures reproduced with this change's tracked edits stashed at the base commit
gates.default_catalog: test_corpus_manifest_v2 and test_crud_coverage_index both pass, so the checked catalog_sha256 and content_set_sha256 did not move
